name: watchermcp
description: Read Hardware Overwatch telemetry receipts, cases, plans and tender records through three isolated MCP trust zones.

interface.shortDescription: Read hardware telemetry, cases and tender evidence
interface.longDescription: Analyze the local Hardware Overwatch evidence store through separate fleet, records and market MCP servers. Tools are read-only and cannot approve plans, issue permits or execute hardware actions. Requires Python 3.11+, the installed watchermcp package and an existing database.
defaultPrompt: Summarize the latest hardware telemetry and cite the receipt IDs.
Review open hardware cases and their proposed maintenance plans.
Summarize the recorded simulation tender comparisons and missing qualification evidence.
